Definition: a Grizite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The word Gizrîy carries the sense of a Gezrite, an inhabitant of Gezer. In 1 Samuel 27:8, the text says "and the Gezrites."
TheologicalSignificance: In gizrîy I find no hidden theology; it simply means a Gezrite, an inhabitant of Gezer.
